crossRefs.note: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

parallels.note: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Perez
people.line: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus
